description: Every unifier of \(f(x_0,a)\doteq f(b,x_1)\) has \(\sigma(x_0)=b\) and \(\sigma(x_1)=a\).
signature:

  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
      [(Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 0)
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant a),
          Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.binary f (Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.constant b)
            (FirstOrder.Language.var 1))]) :
  σ 0 = FirstOrder.Language.func b Fin.elim0 ∧ σ 1 = FirstOrder.Language.func a Fin.elim0
